title: Business Bronze Rewards Card: New Customer Promo Offer Details
summary: Details the Business Bronze Rewards Card new-customer promo from 2025-10-01 through 2026-03-31: make net new purchases totaling $10,000 within the first 2 months of account opening to receive a $500 statement credit. It explains that only posted net purchases count, tracked in the account dashboard, and the credit appears on a future statement after confirmation.
